observations: The funnel frame stands proud of the front-top roof when pushed into the opening.
The fit is tight. The photos show a raised flange edge.
said: We are what appears to be about two layers there too high when the funnel frame sets down into the front top there.

But it looks like even with that, because that is a pretty freaking tight friction fit, we're just a little bit high here, and so we need to add enough more clearance to bring it down based on what you see in the photo there, which I think is about two layers of our print there at the top.
Just give me a coupon of something I can set in here to test your implementation.
scope: The photographs and hand fit establish incomplete seating. They do not measure the gap or isolate the interfering face.
